attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate NJ state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. Result is NJ "entire net income" (NJ's term for taxable income base).

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NJ state additions and subtractions; Calculate NJ state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; set nj_result.entire_net_income = apportionment.state_taxable_income;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef apportionment.state_taxable_income cvd /nj_result.entire_net_income xdef

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - zero adjustments; No nexus - no state adjustments calculated
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_additions = 0.0; set apportionment.state_subtractions = 0.0; set nj_result.entire_net_income = 0.0;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvd /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef 0.0 cvd /nj_result.entire_net_income xdef

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate NJ state corporate income tax. Applies NJ 9% base tax rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NJ tax at 9% base rate; Calculate NJ state tax at 9% base rate, subtract credits
action_details.action_dsl: set apportionment.state_tax = the maximum of (apportionment.state_taxable_income * nj_apportionment.state_tax_rate - apportionment.state_credits) and (0.0); set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax;
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income nj_apportionment.state_tax_rate fmul apportionment.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax f- cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate NJ Corporation Business Tax surtax for large corporations. Surtax is 2.5% of entire net income for income > $1M.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have NJ nexus; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq } over not if

condition_details.condition_comment: Entire net income exceeds $1,000,000 surtax threshold; result.nj_entire_net_income > result.nj_surtax_threshold
Has positive tax base for surtax calculation

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NJ surtax for large corporations; Calculate NJ surtax at 2.5% for income > $1M
action_details.action_dsl: set nj_result.surtax = nj_result.entire_net_income * nj_result.surtax_rate; set apportionment.state_tax = apportionment.state_tax + nj_result.surtax; set apportionment.state_refund_or_owed = apportionment.state_payments - apportionment.state_tax;
action_details.action_postfix: nj_result.entire_net_income nj_result.surtax_rate fmul cvd /nj_result.surtax xdef apportionment.state_tax nj_result.surtax f+ cvd /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax f- cvd /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
